raw_input: Feed post for the new low-rise development. We need people to believe we will actually finish it on time.
core_message: Every unit in the first block is finished and handed over, and the second block is on the same schedule.

audience.description: First-time buyers and small investors aged 30 to 48 who have been burned by delayed developments and are checking whether this one is real.

mandatories: Use photography of the completed block, not a render
